saw_lines: Machine vision buyers don’t browse. They specify by sensor, interface and lens mount, then reorder the same part.
So the sale is won on the spec. Buyers who cannot match sensor and lens move on to a rival who shows it.
Your 40 text Google ads carry developer error messages, not a reason to buy. Rewrite them around one spec, one delivery time and one warranty.
ads_1: Google text ads built on one spec, delivery time and extended warranty
